lines.zh: 我这半棵树用根当腿，走得一瘸一拐。
lines.en: My half-tree walks on roots, limping with every step.

lines.zh: 树皮磨着石头，一路掉木屑。
lines.en: Bark scrapes the stone and sheds sawdust all the way.

lines.zh: 我背着上半身，比背一座山还沉。
lines.en: I carry the upper half, heavier than a mountain on my back.

lines.zh: 黑树脂从我的裂缝里渗出来，黏住草。
lines.en: Black resin seeps from my cracks and glues the grass down.

lines.zh: 我走在最后，因为上面那半截在指挥。
lines.en: I walk last because the upper half is doing the directing.

lines.zh: 每一步都要先把根从土里拔出来。
lines.en: Every step begins by pulling my roots out of the soil.

lines.zh: 我只有下半截，却要负责全部方向。
lines.en: I am only the lower half, yet every direction is mine to choose.

lines.zh: 三个人的树精，走路全落在我这两条根上。
lines.en: In a three-part tree spirit, all the walking lands on my two roots.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，树本来也不该赶路。
lines.en: I walk slowly; a tree was never meant to hurry anywhere.

lines.zh: 树脂滴在身后，蚂蚁排着队来舔。
lines.en: Resin drips behind me and ants line up to lick it.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，声音像旧木门。
lines.en: I step on fallen leaves and sound like an old wooden door.

lines.zh: 再走远一点，我就听不见头顶的唠叨了。
lines.en: A little farther and I will stop hearing the nagging overhead.

lines.zh: 我站在阳光里，假装自己只是棵树。
lines.en: I stand in the sun pretending to be nothing but a tree.

lines.zh: 根须在土下偷偷伸展，像在数地盘。
lines.en: My roots creep underground as if counting out my territory.

lines.zh: 黑树脂凝成一颗小结石，硌着我的皮。
lines.en: The black resin hardens into a little stone against my bark.

lines.zh: 我听见头顶的叶子在替我叹气。
lines.en: I hear the leaves above me sighing on my behalf.

lines.zh: 别踢我的根，那是我唯一的脚。
lines.en: Do not kick my roots; they are the only feet I have.

lines.zh: 我把自己钉在原地，等一场雨。
lines.en: I nail myself in place and wait for rain.

lines.zh: 树皮裂开一道口子，里面全是年轮。
lines.en: A crack opens in my bark, full of rings all the way down.

lines.zh: 我数着路过的小虫，数到一半就忘了。
lines.en: I count the passing bugs and forget the number halfway.

lines.zh: 有人拿斧头靠近，我就装死。
lines.en: When someone comes near with an axe, I play dead.

lines.zh: 下半截最懂什么叫站到腿麻。
lines.en: Only the lower half knows what standing until numb means.

lines.zh: 我把树脂蹭在石头上，磨得发亮。
lines.en: I rub my resin on a stone until it shines.

lines.zh: 上面那半截一摇，我就得站稳。
lines.en: When the upper half sways, I have to brace myself.

lines.zh: 我其实想坐下，可是树不会坐。
lines.en: I would like to sit down, but trees do not sit.

lines.zh: 风停的时候，我听见自己在长。
lines.en: When the wind stops, I can hear myself growing.

lines.zh: 我在等上面那半截说话。
lines.en: I am waiting for the upper half to say something.

lines.zh: 我的根扎得很深，拔不动。
lines.en: My roots go deep; I cannot be pulled up.

lines.zh: 有人砍我一下，我不吭声。
lines.en: Someone chops me once, and I keep quiet.

lines.zh: 我把一片落叶接在枝杈上。
lines.en: I catch a falling leaf on a twig.

lines.zh: 你比我高，也比我多两条腿。
lines.en: You are taller than me and have two more legs.

lines.zh: 你手里的斧头让我树皮发紧。
lines.en: The axe in your hand makes my bark tighten.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子其实是树干。
lines.en: I look up at you with a trunk where a neck should be.

lines.zh: 你踩到我根系了，麻烦挪一挪。
lines.en: You are standing on my roots; please move a little.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上粘着我的黑树脂。
lines.en: There is my black resin stuck to your boot.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，你才发现我是活的。
lines.en: I watched you a long while before you noticed I am alive.

lines.zh: 你身上有松木味，跟我有点像。
lines.en: You smell of pine, a little like me.

lines.zh: 你眼睛的位置，正好是我树杈的高度。
lines.en: Your eyes sit exactly at the height of my branching.

lines.zh: 别把手贴在我的裂缝上，会黏住。
lines.en: Do not put your hand on my crack; it will stick.

lines.zh: 你打算砍我吗？先说好，我很难劈。
lines.en: Are you going to chop me? I should warn you, I split badly.

lines.zh: 我看你，也只是从上往下的下半截。
lines.en: I look at you, and you are also just a lower half from below.

lines.zh: 你绕着我走了一圈，我也想绕你一圈。
lines.en: You walked a circle around me; I would like to circle you too.

lines.zh: 我的树皮裂了，里面是空的。
lines.en: My bark split open, and it is hollow inside.

lines.zh: 疼，但树不太会喊。
lines.en: It hurts, but trees are not much good at shouting.

lines.zh: 那一斧削掉了我一圈年轮。
lines.en: That axe shaved off a whole ring of my growth.

lines.zh: 木屑飞起来，我听见自己响。
lines.en: Sawdust flew, and I heard myself ring out.

lines.zh: 我摇晃着，根松了半寸。
lines.en: I sway, and my roots have loosened half an inch.

lines.zh: 树脂从伤口流出来，黑得像夜。
lines.en: Resin runs from the wound, black as night.

lines.zh: 别打了，我只是一截会走的树干。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I am only a walking piece of trunk.

lines.zh: 疼得我把叶子都卷了起来。
lines.en: It hurts so much that I curl my leaves up.

lines.zh: 上面那半截在喊，我听不清。
lines.en: The upper half is shouting, and I cannot hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 我站不住，膝盖其实是根。
lines.en: I cannot stand straight; my knees are really roots.

lines.zh: 你手里那桶水，比什么都香。
lines.en: That bucket of water smells better than anything else.

lines.zh: 骨粉撒下来的味道，我认得。
lines.en: I know the smell of bonemeal falling.

lines.zh: 泥土松软的地方，我会忍不住挪过去。
lines.en: Where the soil is soft, my feet drag me over.

lines.zh: 你把腐殖土递过来，我就不走了。
lines.en: Hand me that rich soil and I will not leave.

lines.zh: 那点堆肥的气味，让我根须发痒。
lines.en: That whiff of compost makes my roots itch.

lines.zh: 我馋的不是食物，是能扎进去的湿土。
lines.en: I do not crave food; I crave wet soil to sink into.

lines.zh: 你摇了摇水桶，我这条根就软了。
lines.en: You shook the bucket and my root went soft.

lines.zh: 木屑加雨水，这就是我的盛宴。
lines.en: Sawdust and rainwater: that is my whole feast.

lines.zh: 别用胡萝卜逗我，树不吃那个。
lines.en: Do not wave a carrot at me; trees do not eat those.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来松土，我就想跟你回家。
lines.en: You crouch to loosen soil, and I want to follow you home.

lines.zh: 撞到我，等于撞上一截实心木头。
lines.en: Hitting me is hitting a solid length of wood.

lines.zh: 你弹开了，我的树皮只响了一声。
lines.en: You bounced off; my bark made one dull sound.

lines.zh: 别推，我这两条根扎得很深。
lines.en: Do not push; these two roots go deep.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，头顶那半截骂了一句。
lines.en: I wobbled, and the half above me swore.

lines.zh: 你撞的是年轮最厚的地方。
lines.en: You hit the thickest part of my rings.

lines.zh: 我挪不动，你自己绕过去吧。
lines.en: I cannot move aside; go around me.

lines.zh: 这一下撞下来，我掉了三片树皮。
lines.en: That knock cost me three pieces of bark.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像被我蹭了一身树脂。
lines.en: You smell like you wiped my resin all over yourself.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两块旧木头。
lines.en: We collided like two pieces of old timber.

lines.zh: 我站得稳，你走不稳，这很清楚。
lines.en: I stayed steady and you stumbled; that is clear enough.

lines.zh: 树精谈情，是把根悄悄缠在一起。
lines.en: Tree spirits court by quietly tangling their roots.

lines.zh: 我不开花的，只把树脂分你一半。
lines.en: I do not bloom; I just share half my resin.

lines.zh: 两截树皮贴住，要很久才分开。
lines.en: Two pieces of bark pressed together take long to part.

lines.zh: 我落下的种子，是不发芽的那种。
lines.en: The seeds I drop are the kind that never sprout.

lines.zh: 我们交换树脂，就算说好了。
lines.en: We trade resin, and that counts as a promise.

lines.zh: 我想把根须挪到她那边去，可挪不动。
lines.en: I want to shift my roots toward her, but I cannot move.

lines.zh: 树的爱很慢，慢到你以为我没动。
lines.en: A tree loves slowly, slowly enough that you think I am still.

lines.zh: 她树皮的味道，比我自己的好闻。
lines.en: Her bark smells better than my own.

lines.zh: 我把最好的一颗树脂球埋在根下。
lines.en: I bury my finest resin ball beneath my roots.

lines.zh: 别看了，树精也需要一点安静。
lines.en: Look away; even a tree spirit needs some quiet.

lines.zh: 我捡不起东西，根不是手。
lines.en: I cannot pick things up; roots are not hands.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的树脂，我只能盖住它。
lines.en: I can only cover the resin that falls to the ground.

lines.zh: 你把物品放我脚边，我用根圈起来。
lines.en: Set things by my feet and I will ring them with roots.

lines.zh: 我不会捡，只会守着自己这一小片。
lines.en: I do not gather; I only guard this little patch.

lines.zh: 那块树皮是我掉的，请还给我。
lines.en: That bark fell off me; please give it back.

lines.zh: 我试着卷起一颗种子，结果压碎了。
lines.en: I tried to curl around a seed and crushed it.

lines.zh: 东西掉进我树缝里，就归我了。
lines.en: Whatever falls into my seams belongs to me now.

lines.zh: 我看见地上一颗黑树脂，可弯不下腰。
lines.en: I see a black resin lump, but I cannot bend down.

lines.zh: 我的根把石子拢成一堆，纯属巧合。
lines.en: My roots gathered the pebbles into a pile by pure chance.

lines.zh: 你掉的箭头被我黏住了，抱歉。
lines.en: Your arrowhead stuck to me; my apologies.

lines.zh: 谁举斧头，我就盯着谁。
lines.en: Whoever lifts an axe gets my stare.

lines.zh: 那边的脚步声，踩断了我一根根须。
lines.en: Those footsteps just snapped one of my root tips.

lines.zh: 我闻到了锯末味，那不是好东西。
lines.en: I smell sawdust, and that never means anything good.

lines.zh: 有人往这边来了，手握得很紧。
lines.en: Someone is coming this way with a very tight grip.

lines.zh: 我认得那种砍树的架势。
lines.en: I know that stance: it is the stance for felling.

lines.zh: 他踩了我的落果，我记住了。
lines.en: He stepped on my fallen fruit; I remember it.

lines.zh: 前面那个影子，一直在绕着我转。
lines.en: That shadow ahead keeps circling me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把根从土里松开。
lines.en: I slowly loosen my roots from the soil.

lines.zh: 不是所有靠近的都是朋友。
lines.en: Not everything that comes close is a friend.

lines.zh: 他摸了一下我的树皮，我就警醒了。
lines.en: He touched my bark, and I woke right up.

lines.zh: 我盯得更紧了，根已经绷起来。
lines.en: I stare harder, and my roots are already taut.

lines.zh: 你退后，我不想用整棵树压你。
lines.en: Back away; I do not want to drop a whole tree on you.

lines.zh: 我数着他的步子，还有七步。
lines.en: I count his steps: seven more to go.

lines.zh: 树皮底下全是力气，别逼我用。
lines.en: There is strength under this bark; do not make me use it.

lines.zh: 我站得不动，但每根须都在准备。
lines.en: I stand still, but every root tip is getting ready.

lines.zh: 他的斧头还举着，那就别怪我了。
lines.en: His axe is still raised, so do not blame me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过去，根在土里响。
lines.en: I turn slowly and my roots creak in the dirt.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我一倒就能碰到他。
lines.en: At this distance, one fall would reach him.

lines.zh: 我盯得眼睛都没有，他还是怕了。
lines.en: I have no eyes to stare with, and he still got scared.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，我就把树脂甩出去。
lines.en: One more step and I will fling resin at you.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，整棵树皮撞了过去。
lines.en: I turn my flank and ram him with all my bark.

lines.zh: 根抽出来，比棍子还硬。
lines.en: I pull a root free; it is harder than a club.

lines.zh: 这一下用了半圈年轮。
lines.en: That blow cost me half a ring of growth.

lines.zh: 我的树枝扫过去，掉了两片叶子。
lines.en: My branch sweeps across and loses two leaves.

lines.zh: 撞完我自己也晃，但值得。
lines.en: I wobble after the hit, but it was worth it.

lines.zh: 黑树脂糊了他一脸，黏得很。
lines.en: Black resin splatters his face and sticks fast.

lines.zh: 我用最粗的那条根抽他。
lines.en: I lash him with my thickest root.

lines.zh: 他砍我一斧，我还他一整截树。
lines.en: He gives me an axe blow; I give him a whole length of tree.

lines.zh: 打架时我才羡慕上面那半截有手。
lines.en: In a fight I envy the upper half for having branches like arms.

lines.zh: 打完我喘气，树其实不会喘。
lines.en: After the fight I pant, though trees cannot pant.

lines.zh: 我从三棵树的缝隙里长出来。
lines.en: I grew out of the gap between three trees.

lines.zh: 土翻开，一截树皮慢慢立起。
lines.en: The soil turned over and a length of bark stood up.

lines.zh: 这块地原本只该长草，却长出了我。
lines.en: This ground should have grown grass, and it grew me.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先看见的是自己的根。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and the first thing I saw was my own roots.

lines.zh: 上面那半截和我是一起醒的。
lines.en: The upper half and I woke at the same moment.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己算树，还是算别的。
lines.en: I do not know whether I count as a tree or something else.

lines.zh: 落地时我压坏了一小片花。
lines.en: Landing, I crushed a small patch of flowers.

lines.zh: 树皮还湿着，像刚剥下来的。
lines.en: My bark was still wet, as if just peeled off.

lines.zh: 我试着走第一步，差点栽倒。
lines.en: I tried my first step and nearly fell over.

lines.zh: 这里的光线，正好够我长高。
lines.en: The light here is just enough for me to grow tall.

lines.zh: 有人在我出生的坑边站了很久。
lines.en: Someone stood a long time at the pit where I was born.

lines.zh: 我从树桩里爬出来，带着黑树脂。
lines.en: I crawled out of a stump, still covered in black resin.

lines.zh: 火舔上来，我的树脂先烧。
lines.en: Fire licks up and my resin burns first.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔断一根枝。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and snapped a branch.

lines.zh: 水漫过树根，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water rises over my roots and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 炸开的土把我掀翻了半棵树。
lines.en: The blast of soil threw half of me over.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进我的树皮里。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my bark.

lines.zh: 那股味道让我的年轮发晕。
lines.en: That strange smell makes my growth rings spin.

lines.zh: 土里没养分，我的叶子发黄。
lines.en: The soil has no food and my leaves turn yellow.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整截树都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my whole length lit up.

lines.zh: 我掉出世界，根还在抓空气。
lines.en: I fall out of the world with my roots grabbing air.
